subject: Severe Water Contamination in Ward 4
content: The drinking water supply in Ward 4 has been contaminated with sewage for the last 3 days. Several children have fallen ill.

subject: Land Encroachment near Primary School
content: A local builder has illegally constructed a boundary wall encroaching 5 meters into the government primary school playground.

subject: Fluctuating Voltage Damaging Appliances
content: Frequent voltage fluctuations in the evening are damaging household appliances in the main market area.

subject: Request for New Tube Well
content: Farmers in village Sitapur request the installation of a new tube well before the upcoming Rabi season.

subject: Mutation of Property Records Pending
content: My application for the mutation of land records (Khatauni) has been pending for over 6 months without any clear reason.
